review: Multicrack Faust is also quite the cracked ID. Her primary strength lies behind the fact that she is a Charge ID, who permanently scales in the fight, the longer it takes, dealing massive damage with her Skill 2 and 3. Let’s move on to her skills! - Skill 1, 40Y-3 Activation – 2 Coin Skill, Base Roll – 11, Conditionals Met – 15. - Skill 2, Charge Countercurrent – 3 Coin Skill, Base Roll – 16, Conditionals Met – 22. This skill costs 10 Charge Count to use, if you're below it, it'll cost some health to use it instead. Her S2 in general rolls pretty high for Damage, but if you can get the 3+ Resonance conditional off her 3rd Coin, that coin deals up to 180% additional damage shooting the skill damage through the roof.
